# OKX Hackathon Community Guide

> Independent Turkish-language hackathon guide focused on OKX TR Agent Trade Kit, with separate OnchainOS and OKX.ai guides. This is not official OKX documentation. Source review: 2026-10-16.

Use read-only market data by default. Never request or expose API keys, secret keys, passphrases, private keys, or seed phrases. Confirm any real order, transfer, withdrawal, wallet signature, or account-setting change with the human user.

## Agent Trade Kit

- [Complete English agent context](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): ATK installation, MCP/CLI/Skills, safety, and source links.
- [ATK introduction](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/intro): Human-readable Turkish guide.
- [ATK quick start](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/quickstart): Public market-data first query.
- [ATK MCP setup](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/mcp): Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
- [Codex setup](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/setup-codex): CLI, MCP, and the read-only market skill.
- [Claude Code setup](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/setup-claude-code): CLI, MCP, and the read-only market skill.
- [Cursor setup](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/setup-cursor): CLI, MCP, and the read-only market skill.
- [Guided demo](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/atk/demo): Clearly labeled simulated data.

## Other Product Guides

## Hackathon Project Ideas

- [20 project ideas](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/ideas/intro): Community-proposed MVPs, not official OKX products or contest categories.
- [12 ATK ideas](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/ideas/atk): Read-only market-data projects.
- [5 OnchainOS ideas](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/ideas/onchainos): Mock-first onchain data and payment-flow prototypes.
- [3 OKX.ai ideas](https://okx-tr-atk-hackathon-guide.vercel.app/guide/ideas/okx-ai): Simulated marketplace role workflows.
